title: Private Development Coordination
description: Use this service request to review private engineering plans and contracts for private development within a City of Dallas public right-of-way and or easement or questions regarding construction in the listed areas. For information, contact Private Development Coordination at 214-948-4205. The estimated response time for a request of this nature is 3 business days.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about private development plans or construction in a City right-of-way or easement.
actions.why: To request review of private engineering plans or contracts for development within a City of Dallas public right-of-way or easement, or to ask a question about construction in those areas. The 311 request form asks whether the request concerns plat reviews, site plans, engineering plans, infrastructure development, development contracts, three-way contracts, or another topic.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Under "Other Requests", choose "Private Development Coordination"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Under "Other Requests", choose "Private Development Coordination"

actions.tagline: Call Private Development Coordination for information about private development coordination.
actions.why: For information about private development coordination. The description for "Private Development Coordination" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs people to call 214-948-4205.
